# Strange Tale About Animals

> Animal stories and animal facts inspired by Hayat al-Hayawan al-Kubra, the centuries-old Arabic book of animals by al-Damiri — retold in English.

Run by: Sadiq Khan (author and site owner). Companion YouTube channel: "Strange Tale About Animals" (@strangetaleaboutanimals).

## Main sections

- Home: https://sadiqcrazy11-ctrl.github.io/
- Animal of the Day: https://sadiqcrazy11-ctrl.github.io/#animal-of-day
- Animal Stories: https://sadiqcrazy11-ctrl.github.io/#stories
- Animal Facts (articles): https://sadiqcrazy11-ctrl.github.io/#animal-articles
- Animal Symbolism: https://sadiqcrazy11-ctrl.github.io/#animal-symbolism
- Collections: https://sadiqcrazy11-ctrl.github.io/#collections
- Infographics: https://sadiqcrazy11-ctrl.github.io/#infographics
- Videos: https://sadiqcrazy11-ctrl.github.io/#videos
- About the Book: https://sadiqcrazy11-ctrl.github.io/#about-book
- Fun Tools: https://sadiqcrazy11-ctrl.github.io/#fun-tools
- Quiz: https://sadiqcrazy11-ctrl.github.io/quiz.html
- About the Author: https://sadiqcrazy11-ctrl.github.io/#about-author
- Contact: https://sadiqcrazy11-ctrl.github.io/#contact

## Articles

Every animal article opens inside the app at https://sadiqcrazy11-ctrl.github.io/?article=<slug> (examples: ?article=lion, ?article=camel, ?article=ababil). The full list of article URLs is in the sitemap: https://sadiqcrazy11-ctrl.github.io/sitemap.xml
